column1: # Locations granted by game code (docs/research-locations.md A, C, E). Single source for the plugin and the apworld.
# kind = second argument of treasureNumSet(num, kind) as the game passes it, which maps to
#   DROPItemKind(ID, USE, RING, ...): 0 = weapon, 1 = use item, 2 = crest ring.  3 = costume skin (trades only).
# actor = talkactor field (-1 if none). Trades: class "trade", method = _Tradeflag index.
# scene = region for the logic (scene where the reward is obtained).
# category "key": door keys, only locations when keys are shuffled.
